decision: The plan panel updates live as you answer
why: Commitment grows when people see what their answers change.
alternative: A summary page at the end of the wizard.
value: Onboarding feels like building something, not filling a form.

decision: The wizard step lives in the URL and answers autosave per step
why: People abandon and return; support needs to deep-link to a step.
alternative: Keep state in memory until the last step.
value: Resumable onboarding with no lost answers.

decision: Salary is a band with two thumbs, stored in USD
why: Roles post ranges; matching on a single number excludes good fits.

decision: The AI note explains how answers shape practice, never picks roles for you
why: Automation should explain its recommendations while the person keeps the choice.
value: Trust in recommendations without losing agency.
